newsitem.title: GERMANY: Noise warning over Frankfurt freighter night fee.
newsitem.headline: Noise warning over Frankfurt freighter night fee.

text.p: Local authorities in the Frankfurt region have warned a 50 percent cut in night landing fees for freighters at Frankfurt Airport will generate additional noise for residents.

The air noise commission, which represents local authorities close to the airport, said in a statement the fee reduction announced in early August would mean freighter services will be transferred from day to night slots.
Airport authority Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) has cut the charge to encourage more freighter flights and prevent airlines from switching to rival airports such as Amsterdam and Paris.
The air noise commission said although the aircraft would only be low-noise types, the number of night flights and accompanying noise would increase.
"The decades-long efforts of the aircraft noise commission to minimise night impact will be undermined," the statement said.
"The interests of residents close to the airport have not been taken into account," it added.
The commission claimed its view had not been sought before the Hesse transport ministry approved Frankfurt airport's application in August despite the sensibility of the measure.
It called on the relevant authorities to give a clear statement of the noise impact of the freighter fee reduction.
